reference.title: Product version reference
reference.shortdesc: Use the shared BPM header to identify the running product version; documentation has no separate visible version.

section.title: Version location
section.p: The same header on Library, Guided editor, All settings, JSON editor, Compare, and documentation displays the running BPM version. In Library, the workspace count and its “Profiles in library” label are separate concise lines.

section.title: Version scope
section.p: The product version identifies BPM behavior, not the Firefox browser version installed on an endpoint.

section.title: Schema version
section.p: The current release supports Firefox Release 153, Firefox ESR 153.0, and Firefox ESR 140.13. The schema channel is a separate choice that affects validation and available controls.

section.title: Recovery
section.p: If product behavior does not match the guide, record the BPM version, schema channel, route, locale, and visible status before reporting the mismatch.
